local_note: No local sections print in the row stream (the certification banner is on p1). Chancery D9 note (accepted cross-county divergence, see accepted_roster_divergences): this county's portion of Chancery District 9 elects Place 1 only (Bennie L. Richard, sole candidate), while the delta counties' portion (Warren, Issaquena, Sharkey) elects Place 2 only (Vicki Roach Barnes, Penny B. Lawson). The Places partition the district across the counties -- a disjoint printed-ballot split, printed exactly so on each county's own certified recap; no county prints the other's Place. The cross-county roster gate is seat-blind at the (office, district) family, so the two disjoint halves would read as a blocking roster_mismatch; the divergence is accepted here as printed-ballot structure, not a reading error, with every row's arithmetic verified against its own sheet.
